quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: An action that clearly helps someone you care about while costing you something real points to a torn feeling.
quests.explanation: Helping someone at a real, personal cost to yourself is a genuine and common conflict of feeling.
quests.textToSpeak: Recommending her for the transfer gets her away from a manager who's made her last year miserable. It also means losing the one person on my team I never have to double-check.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Someone still learning the basics catching something trained professionals missed points to real admiration.
quests.explanation: Someone still learning catching what trained professionals missed is a genuine cause of being impressed.
quests.textToSpeak: The exchange student, four months into learning the language, corrected a subtlety in the translated contract that our own legal team had missed twice.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Someone solving a hard, private problem for your family without ever making it visible points to a warm feeling.
quests.explanation: Someone quietly solving a hard, private problem for your family, without ever drawing attention to it, is a deep gratitude.
quests.textToSpeak: My daughter's teacher noticed she'd stopped bringing lunch and started quietly packing two every day, never once mentioning it to her directly.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Giving up the effort to correct something, not from apathy but from long experience, points to a settled feeling.
quests.explanation: Giving up on correcting something, after long experience shows it won't help, is a clear resignation.
quests.textToSpeak: I used to correct people when they got the story wrong. These days I mostly just let it go. It's easier, and it doesn't change anything anyway.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A long-standing, entirely predictable habit suddenly stopping without explanation points to a specific unease.
quests.explanation: A long-standing, predictable habit suddenly and inexplicably stopping is a natural cause of worry.
quests.textToSpeak: The dog hasn't barked at the mail carrier once this week. She's barked at him every single day for nine years.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A spontaneous, unplanned togetherness across generations points to a warm, full feeling.
quests.explanation: Spontaneous togetherness across generations, with no one directing it, is a simple, full happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: All three generations ended up in the kitchen at once, nobody assigned to cook, everybody just somehow finding something to do with their hands.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A group continuing a private, unspoken tradition for someone, year after year, with no reminder needed, points to a deep feeling.
quests.explanation: A group continuing a quiet, unspoken tradition for years, without ever needing to be asked, is a profound feeling of being touched.
quests.textToSpeak: My late father's old work crew, most of them retired now themselves, still show up every year on his birthday to fix one thing at my mother's house, no discussion needed.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A claim of proof coming only from a source with a direct financial interest tends to raise doubt.
quests.explanation: A claim backed only by a study from the very company selling the product is a fair basis for skepticism.
quests.textToSpeak: The supplement's label says it's 'clinically proven,' but the only study cited was run by the same company that makes the product.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Watching someone hold onto their own clarity and voice, undiminished, later in life, brings a specific, warm feeling.
quests.explanation: Watching someone hold onto their sharpness and voice undiminished, later in life, is a quiet, real pride.
quests.textToSpeak: My mother, eighty-three, stood up unassisted at the reunion to correct a family story that had been told wrong for twenty years, and got every detail right.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A pile of complex, unfamiliar demands landing all at once, with no clear entry point, points to a flooded state.
quests.explanation: Complex, unfamiliar demands landing all at once, with no clear entry point, is a clear case of feeling overwhelmed.
quests.textToSpeak: The estate paperwork alone is forty pages, my mother needs to move by month's end, and the lawyer keeps using words neither of us fully understands.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Noticing a real, structural difference in someone else's life that you can't simply choose your way into points to a complicated feeling.
quests.explanation: Noticing a structural advantage in someone else's life, one you can't simply choose into, is an honest jealousy.
quests.textToSpeak: My oldest friend married into the kind of family that solves problems by writing a check. Mine solves them by staying up all night arguing about which bill to skip. I love my family. Some nights I still notice the difference.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Letting go of a bigger ambition in favor of the real, smaller purpose in front of you points to a calm feeling.
quests.explanation: Letting go of a bigger ambition in favor of a smaller, real purpose reflects genuine contentment.
quests.textToSpeak: This clinic will never be the biggest one in town, and I stopped needing it to be somewhere around year six. It sees the people it sees, and that's the whole point now.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A plan built entirely on one key assumption that turns out to be false points to a deflated, specific feeling.
quests.explanation: A carefully built plan collapsing over one key assumption proving false is a sharp, real disappointment.
quests.textToSpeak: The whole proposal hinged on the site being zoned for it. The city released the updated map this morning. It isn't.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A stranger giving up real comfort and time, with nothing to gain, purely so you're not alone, points to a warm feeling.
quests.explanation: A stranger sacrificing real time and comfort purely so you're not alone is a deep, direct cause of gratitude.
quests.textToSpeak: The stranger who pulled over for us on the motorway waited the full ninety minutes for the tow truck, in the cold, just so we wouldn't be alone on the hard shoulder.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Rereading unchanged information many times, as though rereading it will reveal something new, points to a restless unease.
quests.explanation: Rereading the same unchanged information many times over is a very familiar, ongoing anxiety.
quests.textToSpeak: Nothing about the custody hearing has moved since Tuesday. I've still reread the same three paragraphs of the filing more times than I can count.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Adjusting your goal downward, from success to simple containment, points to a settled, specific feeling.
quests.explanation: Quietly lowering a goal from success to simple containment, without ongoing bitterness, is a clear resignation.
quests.textToSpeak: I stopped hoping the second location would ever break even. Now I just make sure it doesn't drag the first one down with it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Someone brand new resolving, alone, something that took a whole team the time before points to admiration.
quests.explanation: Someone brand new resolving alone what took a whole team before is a genuine cause of being impressed.
quests.textToSpeak: The new volunteer, on her very first shift, calmed a situation at the shelter that had taken three of us and a locked door to manage the week before.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Knowing details about people's lives through a screen, without any real in-person connection, points to a quiet feeling.
quests.explanation: Knowing details about neighbors only through a screen, without real contact, is a quiet, modern loneliness.
quests.textToSpeak: I know the names of everyone's children in this building from the group chat. I couldn't tell you the last time I actually spoke to any of their parents in person.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A necessary decision that protects many people while devastating one person you know personally points to a torn feeling.
quests.explanation: A necessary decision that helps many while devastating one specific person you know is a genuine, difficult conflict.
quests.textToSpeak: Firing him protects the twelve people whose morale he's quietly been destroying for a year. He also has three kids and a mortgage he mentioned to me just last week.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Watching someone manage, unassisted, something that once required real accommodation points to a specific, warm feeling.
quests.explanation: Watching someone manage independently what once required real support is a deep and specific pride.
quests.textToSpeak: My son, who once needed a written script taped to the phone just to order a pizza, called the insurance company himself today and negotiated the claim without help.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: The same clearly identified problem being treated as new each time it reappears points to a stuck feeling.
quests.explanation: The same identified problem being treated as new every time is a deep, ongoing frustration.
quests.textToSpeak: I've flagged the same recurring defect in four separate production runs now, and each time it's treated as a brand new, unrelated issue.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Someone naturally quiet making significant, visible effort at a single emotional moment for you points to a deep feeling.
quests.explanation: Someone naturally reserved making real, visible effort at one meaningful moment is deeply touching to witness.
quests.textToSpeak: My father-in-law, a man of almost no words in twenty years I've known him, wrote four full pages for my wedding toast and had to stop twice to collect himself reading it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A small pattern of initiative slowly returning, without a formal declaration yet, points to a forward-looking feeling.
quests.explanation: A pattern of initiative slowly returning on its own, before anything's officially declared, is a grounded hope.
quests.textToSpeak: Nobody's calling it recovery yet. But this is the third week in a row he's asked to go outside on his own, and we've stopped needing to suggest it first.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A gradual, unexplained pulling away from someone's usual way of staying in touch points to a specific unease.
quests.explanation: A gradual, unexplained pulling away from someone's usual habits is a natural, reasonable cause of worry.
quests.textToSpeak: My sister's texts have gotten shorter and further apart over the last month, and she keeps saying she'll call properly 'this weekend.'

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Fully inhabiting the life you have, without measuring it against a plan you set aside, points to a calm feeling.
quests.explanation: Fully inhabiting your actual life, without measuring it against an old, set-aside plan, reflects real contentment.
quests.textToSpeak: We'll never travel the way we planned to before the kids. Watching them fight over the last dumpling at dinner tonight, I didn't miss those plans at all.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Colleagues absorbing your responsibilities instantly, on the one occasion you truly needed it, points to a warm feeling.
quests.explanation: Colleagues absorbing your responsibilities instantly, exactly when you truly needed it, is a clear gratitude.
quests.textToSpeak: The whole night shift covered my rounds without being asked, the one time in four years I had to leave in the middle of a shift for a real family emergency.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A promise of no extra costs printed right beside what looks like an extra cost tends to raise doubt.
quests.explanation: A promise of no hidden fees printed beside what looks like exactly that is a reasonable basis for skepticism.
quests.textToSpeak: The moving company's quote says 'no hidden fees,' printed directly above a separate line item labeled 'processing fee, applied at delivery.'

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Giving up the habit of hoping for a specific turning point, after enough years, points to a settled feeling.
quests.explanation: Giving up the habit of expecting a specific turning point, after enough disappointment, is a quiet resignation.
quests.textToSpeak: I used to think this year would be the one it finally turned around. I've stopped picking a year for that a while ago now.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Watching someone answer an old doubt about them, years later, simply by doing the thing well, brings a warm feeling.
quests.explanation: Watching someone quietly answer an old doubt about them, years later, through their own achievement, is a deep pride.
quests.textToSpeak: My daughter stood in front of the same review board that once told her, at sixteen, that she'd never have the discipline for this work. She's chairing it now.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A visible, tangible sign of restoration becoming real, even without a finish date yet, points to a forward-looking feeling.
quests.explanation: A visible, tangible sign of restoration, even without a set finish date, is a grounded and genuine hope.
quests.textToSpeak: The scaffolding came down off the old theater this week. It's not open yet, and there's no date. But you can see the whole front of it again for the first time in three years.
